info.name: FLOW - Entity CRUD
info.description:
Entity page operations on real DS entities.

NO schema needed — entities come from datasource directly.
Creates DS → entity subgraph → create entity (dataSourceUri+properties),
add property (mappedColumnUri), merge properties, create from existing,
relationship CRUD, delete + verify.
Pass --env-var 'skip_cleanup=true' to keep DS for inspection.
